reconciliationOracle.python:
import json, pathlib, copy, hashlib, collections
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
assert str(root) == "/home/devuser/Documents/Projects/sceneaxi", "wrong application cwd"
base = root / "docs/audits/production-swarm"
report_path = base / "repair-review-2026-10-02/fix-missing-capabilities.json"
d = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
l = json.loads((base / "repair-review-2026-10-02/ledger.json").read_text())
m = json.loads((base / "MEGALIST.json").read_text())
g = json.loads((base / "deep-review-2026-10-02/07-goal-accounting.json").read_text())
mi = {r["id"]: r for r in m["canonicalRoots"]}
gi = {r["id"]: r for r in g["missingAcceptanceMap"]}
li = {r["id"]: r for r in l["rows"]}
def normalize(value):
    if isinstance(value, str): return [value] if value.strip() else []
    if isinstance(value, list): return [a for v in value for a in normalize(v)]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        if isinstance(value.get("description"), str):
            return [str(value.get("id", "requirement")) + " (" + str(value.get("kind", "requirement")) + "): " + value["description"] + (" [task " + str(value["task"]) + "]" if "task" in value else "")]
        return [json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)]
    return []
def validate(report):
    original = report["originalAcceptanceMap"]
    assert len(original) == 113 and {r["id"] for r in original} == set(l["originalLocalIds"]), "original113 missing/duplicate"
    rows = report["taskOutcomes"]
    assert len(rows) == 355 == len({r["id"] for r in rows}) and {r["id"] for r in rows} == set(li), "all355 provenance IDs not retained"
    by = {r["id"]: r for r in rows}
    for r in original:
        assert r["canonicalAcceptanceRaw"] == mi[r["id"]]["acceptance"] == gi[r["id"]]["finalAcceptance"], "raw canonical assertion loss"
        assert r["canonicalAssertions"] == normalize(r["canonicalAcceptanceRaw"]) == by[r["id"]]["canonicalAssertions"], "normalization loses canonical clause"
        assert r["acceptance"]["command"].strip() and r["acceptance"]["cwd"] == str(root), "blank executable acceptance/wrong cwd"
    assert len(report["missing53AcceptanceMap"]) == 53 and {r["id"] for r in report["missing53AcceptanceMap"]} == set(l["missing53Ids"]), "missing53 set mismatch"
    claims = {r["id"] for r in rows if r["historicalFinishClaims"]}
    assert set(l["originalLocalIds"]) - claims == set(l["missing53Ids"]), "missing53 not independently finish-derived"
    reviews = {r["id"] for r in l["rows"] if r["category"] == "deep-review-finding" and not r["id"].startswith("08-")}
    assert len(reviews) == 35 and {i for f in report["reviewOverlapFamilies"] for i in f["findingIds"]} == reviews, "review overlap drops predicate"
    required_families = {"LOCAL-ADAPTER-VS-SIGNING", "IMPORT-CAPACITY", "DURABLE-RESPONSE-CODEC", "HOSTILE-DIAGNOSTIC", "SHARP-APPLICABILITY", "VISIBLE-REFUSAL", "KEYBOARD-SEMANTICS", "FOCUS-GEOMETRY-PARTIAL"}
    assert required_families.issubset({f["id"] for f in report["reviewOverlapFamilies"]}), "distinct acceptance family lost under shared finding ID"
    for r in rows:
        assert r["canonicalAssertions"] and all(isinstance(a, str) and a.strip() for a in r["canonicalAssertions"]), "blank/nontext clause"
        assert r["acceptance"]["command"].strip() and r["acceptance"]["cwd"] == str(root), "missing executable plan"
        assert r["status"] == li[r["id"]]["status"], "unapproved external/intentional reclassification"
        assert r["verificationState"] == "NOT_EXECUTED_BY_THIS_LANE" and not r["fullProductionClosed"], "borrowed product green"
        assert [o["assertion"] for o in r["oracleBindings"]] == r["canonicalAssertions"] + r["expandedAssertions"], "oracle clause loss"
        assert all(o["state"] == "NEEDS_NAMED_CURRENT_ARTIFACT_ORACLE" and not o["evidence"] for o in r["oracleBindings"]), "invented executed assertion"
    assert not report["sourceWrites"] and report["publishedStatus"] == "NOT_VERIFIED" and report["fullProductionStatus"] == "NOT_MET", "artifact/source authority leak"
validate(d)
mutations = [
    lambda x: x["originalAcceptanceMap"].pop(),
    lambda x: x["originalAcceptanceMap"][0].update(canonicalAssertions=[""]),
    lambda x: x["reviewOverlapFamilies"].pop(),
    lambda x: x["taskOutcomes"][0].update(status="EXTERNAL_BLOCKER"),
]
for mutate in mutations:
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(d)
    mutate(candidate)
    try: validate(candidate)
    except AssertionError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError("negative report mutation wrongly admitted")
print("PASS_AFTER:113 canonical+independent assertions;53 finish-derived IDs;355 records;35 review predicates;4 negative reporting mutations refused.")
print("Retained dispositions:", dict(collections.Counter(r["status"] for r in d["taskOutcomes"])))
print("Scope: reporting invariant proof only; zero app/published/full-production acceptance inferred.")
